name: Fresh Top Sirloin Steak (Center-Cut, Fat Trimmed)
whyItWorks: A naturally lean steak cut from the sirloin primal. Trimmed of the outer fat strip, it provides robust beef flavor with low lipid load and zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grill or pan-sear medium. Slice thinly against the grain to ensure short muscle fibers that chew smoothly.
